name: labs/iridiumwastaken__pumpy3
title: Harvard PHD 2000 syringe pump (pumpy3.Pump2000)
intro: Harvard PHD 2000 syringe pump (pumpy3.Pump2000), adapted from iridiumwastaken/pumpy3. It reads `infused_volume` and `running`; sets `diameter`, `rate` and `target_volume`; runs `start_pump` and `stop_pump`. `start_pump`: start infusing or withdrawing with the rate and target volume already configured. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
